PLANNED WATER SUPPLY SHUTDOWN - HELENVALE

18 November 2026

The Nelson Mandela Bay Municipality advises residents of Helenvale (Wards 13 and 32) of a planned water supply shutdown on Thursday, 19 November 2026.

The shutdown is necessary to facilitate maintenance work involving the connection of a new 150mm water main to the existing 700mm water main along Gail Road.

 Affected streets:
* Kobus Road
* Voisen Road
* Deverell Road

Duration: Approximately 8 hours (starting from 08h00)

The Municipality has completed all necessary groundwork and preparations ahead of the planned shutdown.

Please note that no water supply disruptions are anticipated in the surrounding areas.

The Municipality apologises for any inconvenience caused and appreciates residents’ patience, understanding and cooperation while this work is being carried out.

WATER SUPPLY DISRUPTION - CHATTY AND SURROUNDING AREAS

18 November 2026

The Nelson Mandela Bay Municipality advises residents of a burst bulk water main on the supply line to Chatty Reservoir, resulting in water supply interruptions in the following areas:

AFFECTED AREAS:

* Khayamnandi
* Reservoir Hills
* Joe Slovo
* Kingston
* Winnie
* Mahashe
* Parts of Bloemendal (Chatty 5, 12, 13 and 14)

Municipal maintenance teams are on site assessing the extent of the damage and carrying out the necessary repairs to restore water supply as quickly as possible.

As a temporary measure to support water availability, Bloemendal will be isolated to assist with maintaining supply to Chatty Reservoir. Water tankers will also be dispatched to affected areas to provide alternative water supply.

The Municipality apologises for the inconvenience caused and appeals to residents to use available water sparingly while repair work is underway.

Residents are thanked for their patience, understanding and cooperation.
